verdict: Lead volume has collapsed this week; we're moving fast to fix it.
narrative: This period delivered 7 leads at a cost of $231.73 each — a sharp drop driven by two forces hitting at once: Google Business Profile activity fell 69% in the last 7 days, with two of your three profiles generating almost no calls, and the last three days of the period produced zero leads. The paid campaigns are spending and recording conversions, but a gap between Google Ads conversions and confirmed leads means website tracking is being repaired so that number reflects reality. On the organic side, your Quality HVAC Solutions profile is performing at more than twice the call rate of the other two profiles, and those profiles are being prioritized for immediate optimization. Heating season campaigns are on track to go live October 1, which should bring lead volume back up as search demand rises.
